Just to get some discussion started, let's pass around our favorite philosophical areas.

I happen to like a lot of areas, but my top three would be (1) morality, (2) epistemology, and (3) criminal philosophy.

Maybe it is just because I study Criminology, but all three of those topics seem to bleed into the science of criminal behavior: morality governs what society decides (or does not decide) to criminalize, epistemology is found in studies on how people even learn to commit crimes (learning theory is a major one, but also stuff like Do video games cause violent behavior? is another), and of course criminal philosophy itself are all the questions or theories that criminology tries to answer.
